commands.name: template-excludes-exactly-canvas-hooks
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; env=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')).get('env') or {}; ids={s.strip().lower() for s in env.get('ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS','').split(',') if s.strip()}; sys.exit(0 if ids=={'session-start:plan-canvas-sessions','stop:plan-canvas-pending'} else 1)"

commands.name: template-keeps-existing-env-keys
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; env=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['env']; sys.exit(0 if env['ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL']=='claude-opus-5[1m]' and env['CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TELEMETRY']=='1' and env['ECC_CONTEXT_MONITOR_COST_WARNINGS']=='0' else 1)"

commands.name: drift-fails-without-exclusion
commands.run: d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/.claude"; python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); t['env'].pop('ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS', None); json.dump(t, open(sys.argv[1], 'w'), indent=2)" "$d/.claude/settings.json"; if HOME="$d" sh claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"; then exit 1; fi; grep -q 'does not exclude the Plan Canvas hooks' "$d/err"

commands.name: canvas-isolation-suite-skips-without-ecc
commands.run: out="$(ECC_PLUGIN_ROOT=/nonexistent sh claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh)" && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^SKIP: ' && if ECC_PLUGIN_ROOT=/nonexistent PLAN_CANVAS_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi

commands.name: canvas-isolation-suite-fails-without-template-value
commands.run: test -f claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh || exit 1; d="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; mkdir -p "$d/claude"; python3 -c "import json,sys; t=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl')); t['env'].pop('ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS', None); json.dump(t, open(sys.argv[1], 'w'), indent=2)" "$d/claude/settings.json.tmpl"; if (cd "$d" && PLAN_CANVAS_TEST_REQUIRE_ECC=1 sh "$OLDPWD/claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh" >"$d/out" 2>"$d/err"); then exit 1; fi; grep -q '^FAIL  stop: pending personal feedback in this repo is not delivered' "$d/err"

commands.name: claude-md-documents-exclusion
commands.run: grep -q 'ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS' CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh' CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'session-start:plan-canvas-sessions' CLAUDE.md && grep -q 'stop:plan-canvas-pending' CLAUDE.md

commands.name: changed-files-within-scope
commands.run: git diff --name-only 41dd7a164e858ca23dbda077dbbc2f69478118b3 HEAD | grep -v '^docs/' | grep -v '^claude/contracts/' | sort > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-changed.$$"; printf '%s\n' CLAUDE.md bin/dotfiles-tests claude/hooks/claude-hooks.test.sh claude/hooks/plan-canvas-isolation.test.sh claude/settings.json.tmpl install/claude-links.test.sh | sort > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-allowed.$$"; test -s "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-changed.$$" && ! comm -23 "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-changed.$$" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-allowed.$$" | grep -q .; rc=$?; rm -f "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-changed.$$" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pc-allowed.$$"; exit $rc

commands.name: no-zsh-or-links-edits
commands.run: ! git diff --name-only 41dd7a164e858ca23dbda077dbbc2f69478118b3 HEAD | grep -qx -e zsh/functions.zsh -e install/common/claude-links.sh
